{"text": "The function `inspect_main` is a debugging utility that prints out the contents of an inventory file used by Sphinx's intersphinx extension.", "type": "intent"},
{"text": "The function `inspect_main` accepts a single argument named `argv`.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The argument `argv` is expected to be a list containing one element, the path or URL to the inventory file.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "If no argument is provided to `inspect_main`, it prints an error message and returns 1.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The function `inspect_main` uses a mock configuration object to call `_fetch_inventory`.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The function `inspect_main` uses the helper `_fetch_inventory` to retrieve the inventory data from the specified location.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The function `inspect_main` iterates over the sorted keys of the inventory data.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The function `inspect_main` prints each inventory key followed by its associated entries, formatted with their display names and URL paths.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "If a `ValueError` is raised during `inspect_main` execution, the function prints the error message and returns 1.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "If any exception other than `ValueError` is raised during `inspect_main` execution, the function prints an unknown error message and returns 1.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "If no errors occur in `inspect_main`, the function returns 0.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The function `inspect_main` has side effects of printing to standard output and standard error depending on its execution path.", "type": "behavioural"}
]
